faq.title: Color Lab FAQ
faq.subtitle: Common questions about our local extraction engine.

items.q: Is the image color picker free?
items.a: Yes, the tool is completely free to use with no hidden costs or limits.

items.q: Are my images uploaded to servers?
items.a: No. All processing happens locally inside your browser using the Canvas API. Your images never leave your device.
We support PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP, GIF, SVG, AVIF, BMP, ICO, and more.

items.q: Can I export Tailwind CSS colors?
items.a: Yes. Our tool allows you to instantly export generated palettes into Tailwind-ready configuration objects or CSS variables.

items.q: Does the tool work on mobile devices?
items.a: Yes. The tool is fully responsive and optimized for mobile browsers, allowing you to extract colors from your gallery or camera capture.

items.q: Can I use the extracted palettes commercially?
items.a: Absolutely. Any color palette generated with SafeTools can be used in personal or commercial projects without attribution.
